show.description:
Aroshi, heir to Mittal Sweets and Namkeen, learns that her husband Shlok and best friend Riddhi swapped her newborn to seize her empire. She secretly reverses the switch and raises both boys, waiting 18 years for revenge.

On their 18th birthday, as Shlok and Riddhi plot to take over and kill her, Aroshi’s plan unfolds—revealing shocking truths, uniting her sons, and, with Raghu (the powerful RK Shekhawat), exposing the betrayal and reclaiming her legacy.
